# Microsoft  Solutions

Bring calling, meetings, and hybrid work into one platform.

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![Signature Microsoft Teams Room with arc table and four chairs in Denver](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Signature-Microsoft-Teams-Room-with-arc-table-and-four-chairs-in-Denver.jpg)

### Our Microsoft Practice

With **Teams Phone, Teams Rooms, and Teams Premium** you get intelligent productivity, richer engagements, flexible workspaces, and built-in security. With a Teams Premium license you get **Microsoft Places** included. Plus, with **Copilot in Teams**, AI helps your teams work smarter every day.

[Contact](https://avispl.com/microsoft/#contact)

## OurMicrosoftExpertise

AVI-SPL is a Microsoft Managed Partner and Microsoft Modern Work Solutions Partner. Our team is ready to plan, deploy, and manage your Microsoft environment for you, including:

- [**Microsoft Teams and Teams Rooms**](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams)
- [**Microsoft Teams Services**](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams-services/)
- [**Microsoft Copilot**](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams/)
- [**Microsoft Places**](https://avispl.com/blog/why-microsoft-places-is-a-workplace-management-gamechanger/)

![Microsoft Places floor plan diagram showing a selected room’s availability and tech features.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Places-Room-Diagram.png)

### Designing a Smart Workplace for IDRC

AVI-SPL helped IDRC design a smart workplace that’s simpler to navigate, AI-ready, easier to manage, and ready for the demands of modern work.

With Microsoft Teams Premium and Places, employees can quickly find available meeting spaces from anywhere without double-booking concerns or equipment surprises.

[**Read the case study to learn more.**](https://avispl.com/resources/case-studies/idrc-case-study/)

[Read the Case Study](https://avispl.com/resources/case-studies/idrc-case-study/)

![Man entering a Microsoft Teams Room](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Crestron_Sightline_assets_entering_002_edit.jpg)

### Interoperability Support

Work with the provider who understands Microsoft collaboration. Our experts design interoperable solutions that support your teams preferred devices and control systems including [Cisco](https://avispl.com/cisco/), [Crestron](https://avispl.com/crestron/), [HP Poly](https://avispl.com/hp-poly/), [Logitech](https://avispl.com/logitech/), [Neat](https://avispl.com/neat/), [Pexip](https://avispl.com/pexip/), and [Q-SYS](https://avispl.com/q-sys/).

Let us be your partner in designing and delivering an effective Microsoft collaboration strategy to meet your business and end-user needs. When you work with AVI-SPL, we:

- Deliver value – improve your team productivity and efficiency and measure the benefits with actionable data insights
- Enhance user experience – ensure secure, seamless, and a positive user experience
- Ease IT operations – manage the planning, implementation, and support of your Microsoft solutions to achieve your goals

##### Deployment

We skillfully plan, deploy, and manage Microsoft Teams, Teams Phone, Microsoft Places, Microsof Copilot, and Microsoft devices.

##### Infrastructure    review

Advice on workflow, design, infrastructure, and integration for optimal enterprise collaboration.

##### Integration

Certified Microsoft engineers ensure collaboration spaces operate seamlessly for all users across locations.

##### Support    Services

Experience expert 24/7 help desk support for all your video collaboration services for the Microsoft ecosystem.

##### Training and    Adoption

We offer online training, in-room signage, and application support to ensure long-term, effective adoption.

##### As-a-Service

Bundle hardware, software, training, services, and support into one easy monthly payment plan.

![Four people sit at a conference table facing a large screen for a video call in a sleek, well-lit room with blue accents.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/AVI-SPL_SignatureMicrosoft_0003_-scaled.jpg)

### Experience Tours

Signature Microsoft Teams Room tours are available now. Experience the immersive Microsoft front-row setup.

[Take a virtual tour or book an on-site visit today!](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams-room-experience-tours/)

[Explore](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams-room-experience-tours/)

## Howcan  wehelp?

Discover how AVI-SPL’s Microsoft Practice can transform your collaboration landscape, enhance productivity, and support your organization’s strategic objectives. We offer:

[Explore](https://avispl.com/microsoft/#contact)

- ###### Comprehensive collaboration   solutions at your fingertips




Engage our Microsoft Practice team to explore how to power your hybrid workplace with Microsoft Teams and AI.

- ###### Strategic business and    technology alignment




The team’s subject matter experts can advise and guide you through seeding and proof-of-value programs that align with your business needs. The practice offers strategic roadmap services to establish the link from what’s possible to real business outcomes.

- ###### Tailored adoption and    support services




The first part of your journey is crucial. Let AVI-SPL help you define your business outcomes and plan your implementation, engage your user community, maximize business value, and track success.


### Let AVI-SPL manage your    Microsoft spaces
